title: [Bug] Anthropic /v1/messages drops PD bootstrap fields during AnthropicMessagesRequest → ChatCompletionRequest conversion
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [x] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

In PD disaggregation mode, external routers attach PD coordination metadata (`bootstrap_host`, `bootstrap_port`, `bootstrap_room`) to inference request bodies. The OpenAI path (`/v1/chat/completions`) accepts these fields via `ChatCompletionRequest` and PD works as expected.

The Anthropic path (`/v1/messages`) does not preserve this metadata. Requests are parsed as `AnthropicMessagesRequest` (which has no PD routing fields), then converted to `ChatCompletionRequest` in `AnthropicServing._convert_to_chat_completion_request()` using only Anthropic-native fields. As a result, `bootstrap_room` (and related PD fields) are dropped before the request enters the existing PD disaggregation flow.

On the decode worker, this surfaces as:

`Invalid request: Disaggregated request received without bootstrap room id`

The same request body with the same bootstrap fields succeeds on `/v1/chat/completions`.

Note: `/v1/messages/count_tokens` is unaffected because it only tokenizes locally and does not enter the PD generation/KV-transfer path.

This appears related to the fix proposed in #33076.

### Reproduction

# Prefill
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path /path/to/model \
  --disaggregation-mode prefill \
  --disaggregation-bootstrap-port 9100 \
  --disaggregation-transfer-backend ascend \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000
# Decode
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path /path/to/model \
  --disaggregation-mode decode \
  --disaggregation-bootstrap-port 9100 \
  --disaggregation-transfer-backend ascend \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30001

# Shared PD fields
{
  "bootstrap_host": "<prefill_host_ip>",
  "bootstrap_port": 9100,
  "bootstrap_room": 123456789
}

# Test 1 — OpenAI works
curl -s -X POST "http://<decode_host>:30001/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "<model_name>",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
    "max_tokens": 32,
    "stream": false,
    "bootstrap_host": "<prefill_host_ip>",
    "bootstrap_port": 9100,
    "bootstrap_room": 123456789
  }'

Expected: HTTP 200, normal completion.

# Test 2 — Anthropic fails (same bootstrap fields)
curl -s -X POST "http://<decode_host>:30001/v1/messages" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "<model_name>",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
    "max_tokens": 32,
    "stream": false,
    "bootstrap_host": "<prefill_host_ip>",
    "bootstrap_port": 9100,
    "bootstrap_room": 123456789
  }'

Actual:
{
  "type": "error",
  "error": {
    "type": "BadRequestError",
    "message": "Invalid request: Disaggregated request received without bootstrap room id. req.rid='...'"
  }
}
